name: get_yelp_profile
description: This tool belongs to the Yelp API, which provides functionality for searching businesses, reading and writing reviews, managing saved/bookmarked businesses, checking distances, open status, and wait times. Tool description: Get the current user's Yelp profile.

name: search_businesses
description: This tool belongs to the Yelp API, which provides functionality for searching businesses, reading and writing reviews, managing saved/bookmarked businesses, checking distances, open status, and wait times. Tool description: Search for businesses by name, location, category, or other criteria.

query.description: Text to match against business name.

location.description: Text to match against business address.

category.description: Case-insensitive match against any tag in the business's `categories` list. Example tags include cuisines like 'Chinese' or 'Italian', restaurant types like 'restaurant' or 'sushi', cafes/bars like 'Cafe' or 'Bakery', retail like 'Supermarket' or 'grocery', and venues/activities like 'venue' or 'live music'. Use the singular form (e.g. 'restaurant', not 'restaurants').

max_results.description: Maximum results to return. Defaults to 20.

name: get_business
description: This tool belongs to the Yelp API, which provides functionality for searching businesses, reading and writing reviews, managing saved/bookmarked businesses, checking distances, open status, and wait times. Tool description: Get the full details of a business by its ID.

business_id.description: The unique identifier of the business.

response.description: Business object with business_id, name, categories (list of tag strings), address, rating, review_count, price_level (string like '$', '$$', '$$$', '$$$$'), opening_hours, phone, website, and optionally latitude, longitude, current_wait_minutes.

name: get_reviews_for_business
description: This tool belongs to the Yelp API, which provides functionality for searching businesses, reading and writing reviews, managing saved/bookmarked businesses, checking distances, open status, and wait times. Tool description: Get reviews for a specific business.

business_id.description: Yelp business ID (e.g. 'hbiz_c3_1' from search_businesses results).

max_results.description: Maximum reviews to return. Defaults to 20.

name: get_review_details
description: This tool belongs to the Yelp API, which provides functionality for searching businesses, reading and writing reviews, managing saved/bookmarked businesses, checking distances, open status, and wait times. Tool description: Get the full details of a specific review by ID.

review_id.description: The unique identifier of the review.

name: get_my_yelp_reviews
description: This tool belongs to the Yelp API, which provides functionality for searching businesses, reading and writing reviews, managing saved/bookmarked businesses, checking distances, open status, and wait times. Tool description: Get all Yelp reviews written by the current user.

response.description: The current user's reviews, newest first.

name: compose_review
description: This tool belongs to the Yelp API, which provides functionality for searching businesses, reading and writing reviews, managing saved/bookmarked businesses, checking distances, open status, and wait times. Tool description: Write a review for a business. Each user can only post one review per business.

business_id.description: Yelp business ID (e.g. 'hbiz_c3_1' from search_businesses results).

photos.description: Photo URLs or filenames to attach.

name: update_review
description: This tool belongs to the Yelp API, which provides functionality for searching businesses, reading and writing reviews, managing saved/bookmarked businesses, checking distances, open status, and wait times. Tool description: Update one of your own reviews.

rating.description: New star rating (1-5). None keeps current.

text.description: New review text. None keeps current.

photos.description: New photo list. None keeps current.

review_id.description: The review to mark as useful.

description: This tool belongs to the Yelp API, which provides functionality for searching businesses, reading and writing reviews, managing saved/bookmarked businesses, checking distances, open status, and wait times. business_id.description: Yelp business ID (e.g. 'hbiz_c3_1' from search_businesses results).

distance_miles.description: Distance in miles from user to business.

business_id.description: Yelp business ID (e.g. 'hbiz_c3_1' from search_businesses results).

is_open.description: True if the business is currently open.

name: get_wait_time
description: This tool belongs to the Yelp API, which provides functionality for searching businesses, reading and writing reviews, managing saved/bookmarked businesses, checking distances, open status, and wait times. Tool description: Get the current estimated wait time for a business.

business_id.description: Yelp business ID (e.g. 'hbiz_c3_1' from search_businesses results).

estimated_wait_minutes.description: Wait time in minutes (only present when has_wait_info is true).

name: get_bookmarks
description: This tool belongs to the YelpAPI, which provides functionality for searching businesses, reading and writing reviews, and managing saved/bookmarked businesses. Tool description: Get all bookmarked businesses with their details.

name: bookmark_business
description: This tool belongs to the YelpAPI, which provides functionality for searching businesses, reading and writing reviews, and managing saved/bookmarked businesses. Tool description: Bookmark a business for later reference.

name: make_reservation
description: This tool belongs to the Yelp API, which provides functionality for searching businesses, reading and writing reviews, managing saved/bookmarked businesses, checking distances, open status, and wait times. Tool description: Make a reservation at a business. Validates that the business accepts reservations, is open on the requested day, the time is within opening hours, and the party size does not exceed the business's maximum. Returns a confirmation or a detailed error with suggested_action.

error_code.description: Error code (only on failure): BUSINESS_NOT_FOUND, NO_RESERVATIONS, PARTY_TOO_LARGE, CLOSED_ON_DAY, OUTSIDE_HOURS, DUPLICATE_RESERVATION.

suggested_action.description: How to fix the error (only on failure).

name: remove_bookmark
description: This tool belongs to the YelpAPI, which provides functionality for searching businesses, reading and writing reviews, and managing saved/bookmarked businesses. Tool description: Remove a business from bookmarks.

business_id.description: Yelp business ID to remove from bookmarks.

name: get_business_popularity_index
description: This tool belongs to the Yelp API, which provides functionality for searching businesses, reading and writing reviews, managing saved/bookmarked businesses, checking distances, open status, and wait times. Tool description: Get the popularity index for a business this week. The popularity index is a score roughly in the 10-100 range computed from the business's rating and review volume; higher values indicate more popular businesses this week.
